templates_list.name: 3d_pixal3d_trellis2_image_to_model
templates_list.title: Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2: Image to Model
templates_list.desc: Upload a single image. Generate a high-fidelity 3D model with PBR textures using either Pixal3D or TRELLIS.2, toggled by a single switch. Both pipelines share the same DINOv3 encoder and shape/texture VAEs; Pixal3D adds MoGe camera estimation for pixel-aligned geometry. Includes background removal and a complete mesh post-processing pipeline: remesh, decimate, UV unwrap, and texture baking.
